variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: Hold variant cooldownStartDelay = 52 (skillHoldCDStarts[0] in gcsim). AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — schema gap; reviewer to extend if needed. Inside-Q Hold cooldownStartDelay also = 52 (skillHoldCDStarts[1]).

Hold Q-cancel: ActionBurst not explicitly set in skillHoldFrames[0] — stays at InitAbilSlice default (103 = AnimationLength). Omitted per rule. gcsim comment labels InitAbilSlice(103) as 'Hold E -> Q', suggesting 103f as Q-cancel; reviewer to verify.

Electro Sigil is a self-status on Razor (not a spawned entity): up to 3 sigils, each grants +20% ER (20% per sigil, stacking), duration refreshes to 18s on new sigil gain (gcsim: AddStatMod with 18*60 frames). Hold E clears all sigils and converts each to 5 Energy. Reviewer to decide effect representation for sigil ER buff.

Skill has two frame sets for outside vs inside Lightning Fang (Q). Outside-Q frames recorded for both variants. Inside-Q Press: swap=75 (ActionSwap explicitly=75), D=32, J=32 (ActionAttack not set → N omitted). Inside-Q Hold: swap=88 (ActionSwap explicitly=88), D=53, J=52.

A1 passive (Awakening) reduces skill CD by 18% at Ascension 1+: Press base 6s → ~4.92s, Hold base 10s → ~8.2s (gcsim: a1CDReduction multiplies by 0.82). Base cooldowns in JSON are pre-A1 values. Also resets skill CD on Q cast (a1CDReset called at burstHitmark=32).
Inside-Q Press cooldownStartDelay = 31 (skillPressCDStarts[1]). Base (outside-Q) Press cooldownStartDelay = 30 recorded on ability.

Hexerei Secret Rite (current-patch, count-gated) hangs off this ability's sigil counter: gcsim skill.go:207-217 clamps c.sigils to 3 and calls thunderFallCB() on overflow; asc.go:50-89 gates it on IsHexerei && GetHexereiCount() >= 2, then queues a 150% ATK Electro strike ("Surge of Lightning", Mult 1.5, hitmark 37) and AddEnergy 7 at 74f, with hexereiICDKey = 60+74 frames (so the next proc is possible 1s after the energy lands → procCooldown 1). Overflow itself (gaining a sigil at 3/3) is not schema-expressible, so the energy effect is authored on factionBonuses with a manual trigger; the 150% ATK strike is left unauthored per the damage-multiplier rule.

Hexerei permanent (gcsim skill.go:198): with C6, each sigil grant adds 3 sigils instead of 1 (`if c.IsHexerei && c.Base.Cons >= 6 { sigils = 3 }`) — bare IsHexerei, no count gate. Sigil cap stays 3, so the practical change is reaching cap (and Secret Rite overflow) in one Press hit. Not modelable: the sigil counter itself is not in the schema.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The caveat talks about an energy refund and a damage strike. The planner has no energy surface at all (Q rows draw cooldowns, never energy), and the strike is damage-only under the constitution and is authored nowhere. Nothing on the timeline is wrong, short, missing or approximate because of this — the reader is being told about a mechanic that never had a place on a Gantt chart. Category: invisible-omission.
abilities.description:
Hunts his prey using the techniques taught to him by his master and his lupical.

Press
Swings the Thunder Wolf Claw, dealing Electro DMG to opponents in front of Razor.
Upon striking an opponent, Razor will gain an Electro Sigil, which increases his Energy Recharge rate.
Razor can have up to 3 Electro Sigils simultaneously, and gaining a new Electro Sigil refreshes their duration.

Hold
Gathers Electro energy to unleash a lightning storm over a small AoE, causing massive Electro DMG, and clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils.
Each Electro Sigil cleared in this manner will be converted into Energy for Razor.

abilities.name: Lightning Fang
_curatorNotes: Wolf Within is a 15-second self-status on Razor (gcsim: AddStatus(burstBuffKey, 15*60) applied at burstHitmark=32), terminated when Razor swaps off-field (event.OnCharacterSwap). Not a spawned entity — not modeled as summons[]. `duration` field removed from ability per recipe. Reviewer to decide representation for the 15s status window.

Wolf Within fires alongside each of Razor's normal attacks, dealing Electro DMG (Mult = wolfDmg[talentLvl] * normalHitMult; AttackTag: ElementalBurst, ICD: ICDTagElementalBurst). Implemented as a QueueAttack callback at delay=1 on each normal hit during burstBuffKey status. ATK SPD buff also applied at burstHitmark.

gcsim burst init comment labels InitAbilSlice(74) as 'Q -> E', suggesting E-cancel at 74f. ActionSkill not explicitly set in burstFrames — stays at InitAbilSlice default (74 = AnimationLength). Omitted per recipe rule. Reviewer to verify E-cancel timing.
'summon' tag appears to be a generator artifact — Wolf Within is a self-status, not a spawned entity. Reviewer to remove or update.
Lightning Fang also: raises ATK SPD and Electro RES, grants Electro-Charged immunity, disables charged attacks, modifies skill radius (3u vs 2.4u) and frames. All runtime-state effects.

Hexerei permanent kit patch (current patch, gcsim burst.go:100-104): each Wolf Within strike adds FlatDmg += 0.7 * TotalAtk — a bare `if c.IsHexerei` check with NO GetHexereiCount gate, so it is unconditional, not Secret Rite. Pure self-damage enhancement → not authored as an effect (site constitution: no damage math); recorded here only. Nate confirmed permanent 2026-07-29.
abilities.description:
Summons the Wolf Within, which deals Electro DMG to all nearby opponents. This clears all of Razor's Electro Sigils, which will be converted into Elemental Energy for him.
The Wolf Within will fight alongside Razor for the skill's duration.

The Wolf Within
·Strikes alongside Razor's normal attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
·Raises Razor's ATK SPD and Electro RES.
·Causes Razor to be immune to DMG inflicted by the Electro-Charged status.
·Disables Razor's Charged Attacks.
·Increases Razor's resistance to interruption.

These effects end when Razor leaves the battlefield.
When Razor leaves the field, a maximum of 10 Energy will be returned to him based off the duration remaining on this skill.

factionBonuses.name: Secret Rite
factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, gaining an Electro Sigil while already at the 3-Sigil cap calls down a lightning strike (150% of ATK as Electro DMG) that restores 7 Energy to Razor, at most once per second.
_curatorNotes: ↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). factionBonuses[hexerei] "Secret Rite" — effects[0] (energy amount 7) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/razor/skill.go:215-218` — inside `addSigil()`, `if c.sigils > 3 { c.sigils = 3; c.thunderFallCB() }`; `asc.go:50-89` then gates on `IsHexerei && GetHexereiCount() >= 2`, queues the 150% ATK strike and `AddEnergy("razor-surge-of-lightning", 7)` at 74f behind a `60+74`-frame ICD. Sigils come from a skill-press hit (`skill.go:121`) and, at C6 outside burst, the Lupus Fulguris strike (`cons.go:97-102`). Retained: the three facts the curator already pinned and that are still true — the count gate (`GetHexereiCount() >= 2`), the 1s effective proc cooldown derivation (`60+74`f ICD vs the 74f energy delay), and the open uncertainty that gcsim does **not** gate `thunderFallCB` on the Wolf Within status though the in-game text reportedly does. Add why it cannot be authored: the trigger is *overflow at the cap*, and the sigil counter is unmodelled on Razor. ⚠️ ⚓ I checked `onStack` and it cannot express this, structurally, not merely for want of a sigil resource: the fire **spends the set**, whereas Razor's sigils stay pinned at 3 after the strike (`c.sigils = 3`), so a fire at N would re-arm only after N more grants instead of on the very next one; and lint B.16 caps `count` at the keys' summed `max`, which is 3, while the overflow is by definition the *fourth* grant. The near-miss re-trigger, `{"type":"onHit","abilityType":"skill","filter":{"damageTag":"skill"}}` (Razor C4's own filter, which correctly excludes Hold-E), would fire on **every** press — 4× the true rate at C0, 2× at C6 — to buy one Team Builder detail-card line, since `energy` draws nothing in the planner. ⚠️ Retiring leaves `"effects": []` on the faction entry; that is already the shipped shape on klee, nicole and varka, C.16 only checks that `factionBonuses` is non-empty, and the entry keeps its name + description.
